leads.title: Liechtenstein Penal Code - Sections 129, 130 repeal and 2000 revision
leads.documents: Decriminalization of same-sex sexual activity in 1989 and equalization of age of consent to 14 in 2001.
leads.detail: Cited in text as removal of Sections 129 and 130 in 1989; Penal Code revised December 2000 effective 2001. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Liechtenstein Penal Code - Section 283(1) and 283(6)
leads.documents: Criminal ban since 1 April 2016 on public incitement to hatred/discrimination and discrimination in public facilities on grounds including sexual orientation, punishable up to 2 years.
leads.detail: Full German and English quote of Section 283(1) reproduced in article. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Act on Media (Mediengesetz), October 2005
leads.documents: Declares media content illegal if it incites or supports discrimination based on sexual orientation among other grounds.
leads.detail: Cited as enacted October 2005. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: State Court (StGH) - September 2019 ruling
leads.documents: Held same-sex marriage ban not unconstitutional but several 2011 partnership law provisions discriminatory, notably ban on stepchild adoption by civil partners; followed 2018 gay couple suit invoking ECHR and Constitution after first-instance win.
leads.detail: Cited as StGH September 2019 decision. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: State Court of Liechtenstein - 15 June 2021 ruling
leads.documents: Ruled registered partners must have right to adopt, invalidated prohibitive sections of 2011 partnership law, gave Parliament one year to rectify.
leads.detail: Cited with date 15 June 2021 and one-year deadline. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Liechtenstein Government report approved October 2022
leads.documents: Found current partnership law uses gender-equitable formulations implying both same-sex and opposite-sex couples can enter registered partnerships.
leads.detail: Cited as report approved by government in October 2022. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Government consultation report 11 July 2023 and proposal adopted 6 February 2024 - Marriage Act, Partnership Act, Personal and Company Act
leads.documents: Legal machinery for same-sex marriage implementation; consultation ended 10 Oct 2023; proposal to stop new partnerships, recognize existing ones and allow conversion to marriage.
leads.detail: Cited with dates 11 July 2023, 10 Oct 2023, 6 Feb 2024; first reading 8 March 2024 24-1, second/final 16 May 2024 24-1, royal assent 9 July 2024, effect 1 Jan 2025. No URL visible.

leads.title: National Legal Gazette (Liechtensteinisches Landesgesetzblatt) - 25 April 2023 issue
leads.documents: Publication of full adoption equality legislation; stepchild adoption passed 6 May 2022, full adoption passed 2nd reading 2 March 2023, effective 1 June 2023.
leads.detail: Cited as issued 25 April 2023, effective 1 June 2023; includes 2 Dec 2022 1st reading 22-3 vote. No URL visible.

leads.title: Department of Equal Opportunities (Stabsstelle für Chancengleichheit) - 22 February 2005 reorganisation
leads.documents: Rights machinery: assignment to include discrimination on sexual orientation in its area of responsibility.
leads.detail: Cited with German name and date 22 Feb 2005. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Liechtensteiner Vaterland - 2017 online poll
leads.documents: Living conditions / public attitudes: 69% majority support for legalisation of same-sex marriage.
leads.detail: Cited as 2017 online poll by Liechtensteiner Vaterland at 69%. No URL visible in provided text.
